page_title: NIC 0-1 ANG | Nice v Angers 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+3' Angers are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Melvin Bard (Nice) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin (Nice) is coming onto the pitch as Charles Vanhoutte cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Yassine Belkhdim will be replaced by Jim Allevinah (Angers).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierrick Capelle (Angers) comes onto the pitch for Louis Mouton.
81' Nice fail to score from a corner as Herve Koffi (Angers) leaps to collect the ball.

80' A neat pass is well received by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball on goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
79' Isak Jansson (Nice) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Herve Koffi pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
78' Haris Belkebla (Angers) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
77' Franck Haise prepares a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho is replaced by Tanguy Ndombele (Nice).
77' Antoine Mendy (Nice) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
75' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:8.
73' Louis Mouton (Angers) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
72' A substitution has been made. Sidiki Cherif is replaced by Harouna Djibirin (Angers).
72' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Prosper Peter (Angers) replaces Amine Sbai.
71' Nice have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
70' Himad Abdelli (Angers) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
65' Carlens Arcus will be replaced by Lilian Raolisoa (Angers).
63' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) replacing Morgan Sanson.
63' That's the end of the game for Sofiane Diop, who is replaced by Isak Jansson (Nice).
61' A long pass finds Morgan Sanson (Nice) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
59' Angers are awarded a mid-range free kick.
54' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Tom Louchet (Nice) has to leave the pitch!

53' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Tom Louchet (Nice), but referee Jeremy Stinat must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Tom Louchet (Nice) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
50' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
49' Angers keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' Franck Haise has made a change at the break. Bernard Nguene (Nice) has come on in place of Juma Bah.
46' Referee Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' None of the Angers players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Louis Mouton (Angers) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
43' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Sofiane Diop (Nice) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Nice is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
41' Antoine Mendy (Nice) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
39' Juma Bah (Nice) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
39' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

33' 0 - 1 Sensational! Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box onto the bottom of the left post and into the net. The assist goes to Carlens Arcus and the score changes to 0:1.
30' Amine Sbai (Angers) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
27' Sofiane Diop (Nice) finds some space for a shot after collecting the ball and unleashes a rocket of a shot from long distance towards the net. The goalkeeper thwarts the effort.
27' The Angers players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Nice are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' The ball has crossed the sideline. Nice are taking a throw-in.
16' Sofiane Diop (Nice) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
9' Sofiane Diop (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
8' Sofiane Diop (Nice) picks up an injury.
7' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) sends a long ball in, but Yehvann Diouf comfortably gathers the ball.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
3' Sofiane Diop (Nice) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
Angers will kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat is the one to supervise the game today.
